title: Lifecycle Object Specification
description: Defines lifecycles of products, versions, and components nested within products.

LifeCycle.description: Represents a lifecycle, containing a list of products and defined lifecycle phases.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the life cycle definition.

lifecycle_scopes_ref.description: A list of lifecycle scopes used within the lifecycle.

lifecycle_phases_ref.description: A list of lifecycle phases used within the lifecycle.

lifecycle_graph.description: A DAG (directed acyclic graph) representation of the life cycle

LifecycleScopes.description: Defines the specific support scopes provided by the lifecycle.

name.description: Defines the name of the support scope.

description.description: A description of what the scope provides.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product definition.

LifecyclePhaseTerms.description: Represents the specific terms (date range) of a the life cycle phase

lifecycle_name_ref.description: A referance to the life cycle phase defintion name that the terms apply to.

start_date.description: The start date of the phase (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if inherited or undefined (phase starts at the close of a prior phase).

end_date.description: The end date of the phase (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if inherited or ongoing.

parent_reference.description: Indicates if the null values for start and end dates inherit (true) or are ongoing (false)

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product life cycle terms.

LifecyclePhase.description: Represents a specific phase (or period) of a lifecycle phase within a version, referencing a defined lifecycle phase name.

name.description: References a name from the parent LifeCycle's lifecycle_phases array.

support_scopes_ref.description: What offering scope are included as part of this life cycle phase

items.description: References a name from the parent LifeCycle's lifecycle_scopes array.

eox_lifecycle_mappings.description: A mapping to an eox life cycle standard phase endings. The end_date from this life cycle phases life cycle terms is used to denote the end date for the mapping phase.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product definition.

ProductVersions.description: Represents a product with its name, vendor, versions, and components.

versions.description: List of versions for this product.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product definition.

Product.description: Represents a product with its name, vendor, versions, and components.

type.description: A type defintion for the product, defining a classification for the product.

alternative_names.description: A list of alternative names and specified context for the alternative name.

name.description: An alternative name used to represent the product.

type.description: A set context for alternative name.

vendor_name.description: The name of the vendor for this product.

components.description: List of components associated with this product.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product definition.

Version.description: Represents a specific version of a product, referencing lifecycle phases from the main schema.

name.description: The name or identifier of the version.

release_date.description: The GA (general avalabilty) date of the version (YYYY-MM-DD).

weight.description: A weight value for the version allowing for ordering when/if the version used doesn't follow symantic versioning.

metadata.description: A list of vendor specific metadata objects to the product definition.

Component.description: Represents a component, an included product or dependency that included/associated with a product.

product_name_ref.description: References the product definition that defines this component as a product.

product_version_ref.description: References the product version definition that defines what version of a product is associated with the component.

life_cycles.description: A list of product life cycles.

life_cycle_phases.description: A list of lifecycle phases options defined for referance by the captured life cycles.

life_cycle_scopes.description: A list of lifecycle scope options defined for referance by the captured life cycles.
